versions.subject: cisco secure firewall detections - third batch
versions.detection:
`cisco_secure_firewall` EventType=IntrusionEvent
| bin _time span=30m
| stats count as TotalEvents values(SignatureID) as SignatureIDs
        values(IntrusionRuleMessage) as RuleMessages 
        min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime 
        by InitiatorIP Classification MitreAttackGroups InlineResult InlineResultReason

| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `cisco_secure_firewall___high_volume_of_intrusion_events_per_host_filter`
